# Vocabulary

How words are made: a **kind** part narrowed by a **which** part (`KIND.WHICH`). A single part is a word
on its own. Any part can also be a **relation**, and numbers (`ONE.0` to `ONE.511`) are built in, so they
are not listed. Status: **preliminary**, 55 words.
